notes: Card: 'ris' x5, 'im' x4, 'is' x2, 'isp' x2, ' crist'/' cris' after 'Cr'/'C' in surnames and place names (Crim Dell, Crimée, Crispi, Crispe, Criswell). Near misses are other names starting with 'Cr' followed by other vowels.
